overview_description.description: Urent is a UAE-based mobility marketplace that enables users to rent and list vehicles through a digital platform. The company offers access to cars, yachts, motorcycles, scooters, and other transport options for short and long-term rentals across the MENA region. It operates a peer-to-peer and commercial rental model that connects vehicle owners, rental businesses, and customers through mobile and web applications. Urent also provides features such as booking management, host coordination, in-app communication, and fleet listing services for mobility providers.
